articles.summary: UWM Holdings Corporation (NYSE: UWMC) (“UWMC”, the “Company” “we,” “our” and “us”), the publicly traded indirect parent of United Wholesale Mortgage (“UWM”), today announced certain preliminary operating and financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, together with updated financial disclosure. The Company is providing this information in advance of the commencement of the measurement period used to determine the subscription price under its previously announced rights offering so that investors have access to updated operating and financial information before the beginning of that period. articles.title: UWM Holdings Announces Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results and Updated Financial Disclosure

articles.summary: UWM Holdings Corporation ( NYSE:UWMC ), the publicly traded indirect parent of United Wholesale Mortgage (UWM), the #1 overall mortgage lender, wholesale and purchase mortgage lender in the U.S., will announce its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. A press release with financial highlights will be available on the company’s Investor Relations website https://investors.uwm.com in the Financials section. The company will also host a QA via Zoom with UWMC Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, Mat Ishbia for financial analysts and investors on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET. Interested participants are encouraged to submit questions in advance by emailing investorrelations@uwm.com no later than 9:30 a.m. ET on November 4, 2026. Participants will also have the opportunity to ask questions live during the call. The Zoom call may be accessed by registering here: https://uwm.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_RqGxxp-XQKaIaIeRpjkbKg
articles.title: UWM Holdings Corporation to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Earnings Q&A
